citations.quote: However, rolldown return is seldom substantial, and will be overwhelmed by even quite small changes in the level or shape of the curve.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Decomposes the market-closed deterministic bond return into carry (yield times elapsed time), pull-to-par, and roll-down (riding the curve), with carry sub-split into risk-free/credit and running/pull-to-par components.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Carry, Roll-Down, and Pull-to-Par Time Decomposition
